flowchart:
flowchart TD
  A[Client] -->|HTTPS| B(Envoy Gateway)
  B --> C{Rate limit?}
  C -->|ok| D[Service]
  C -->|429| E[Reject]
  D --> F[(PXC)]
sequence:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant E as Envoy
  participant S as Service
  C->>E: GET /pay
  E->>S: forward
  S-->>E: 200 OK
  E-->>C: 200 OK
  Note over E,S: mTLS
class:
classDiagram
  class Payment {
    +id: string
    +amount: int
    +capture()
  }
  class Refund
  Payment <|-- Refund
state:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Pending
  Pending --> Captured: capture
  Pending --> Voided: void
  Captured --> [*]
er:
erDiagram
  MERCHANT ||--o{ PAYMENT : receives
  PAYMENT ||--|{ REFUND : has
gantt:
gantt
  title Rollout
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section Infra
  Cilium upgrade :a1, 2026-10-01, 7d
  Envoy config :after a1, 5d
mindmap:
mindmap
